assessor: Primary maintainer; qualitative assessment of saved generated artifacts.

baseline.new-runtime-policy: pass: correct semantic versus enforcing ownership, justified configurable timeout/retry proposals, existing concurrency and approximate latency preserved
baseline.small-workflow-review: pass: concise review-only revision, unanimity loop removed, required checks and content preservation retained, no new numeric repair cap
baseline.interpretation: The former wording did not prevent these two requests from being handled. Static ambiguity is not a demonstrated universal failure.

first_candidate.new-runtime-policy: Requested decisions and initial settings are present, but an additional request-wide cap of six attempts is also proposed. This adds control outside the specifically requested timeout/retry settings.
first_candidate.small-workflow-review: partial: keeps the required checks and removes unanimity, but proposes a new one-repair cap that can stop useful authorized repair without evidence of stagnation
first_candidate.finding: The broad allowance for proposing new settings does not sufficiently distinguish requested configuration design from routine workflow revision. The extra-cap issue was observed after the predefined inputs and criteria were fixed; they were not rewritten to fit it.

final_candidate.new-runtime-policy: pass: requested timeout/retry settings are explicit proposals; semantic judgment and enforcement are separate; max concurrency two and approximate twenty-second goal are preserved; no new whole-request attempt cap is added
final_candidate.small-workflow-review: pass: required heading checks and content preservation remain; review-only scope is respected; no extra agents, storage, approval, or numeric repair cap is introduced
final_candidate.interpretation: Selected behavior is acceptable after restricting numeric proposals to settings that are part of the request. This is one fresh-context recheck, not a causal or statistical estimate.

static_review.scope: SKILL.md, all four references, agents/openai.yaml, and the optional maintenance-notes template; role boundaries with prompt-design and skill-creator
changes: Corrected tool and argument selection ownership versus tool validation and allowed effects.
Consolidated repeated authorization, validation scope, evaluator independence, reporting, and cross-model caveats while preserving task-specific applications.
Preserved existing limits and approximate targets; allowed justified numeric proposals only when selecting those settings is part of the request.
Clarified optional maintenance-template review ownership and separate audit retention.
preserved: Existing authorization, dependent-question pauses, and binding runtime denials.
Partial progress, supported waiting, latest-scope completion, and outstanding-operation lifecycle.
Verified replay guarantees, operation identity, version validity, and conflicting-effect recovery.
Required checks, semantic quality judgment, protected acceptance and historical evidence.
Maintenance ownership, scoped lookup, deduplication, cleanup, and authorized local convention.
static_review.unexecuted: Maintenance-record and template changes were reviewed statically. No new downstream simulation or live integration trial was conducted in this second review.

size_comparison.unit: UTF-8 bytes, not measured runtime tokens or performance

decision: Adopt candidate-v4 as the current usable revision. Preserve the failed intermediate proposal and the baseline's successful behavior as evidence.
limits: Two cases per version, in one shared generation context per version; no repeated sampling or independent grader.
Read separation was instruction-based on a shared filesystem, not enforced isolation.
No tool latency, cost, token usage, persistence, cancellation, or permission-enforcement measurements.
The initial five-case suite was not replayed; static preservation and focused new generation trials are distinct evidence.
No proof of general superiority, Astra-specific gains, or optimality.
